DISASSEMBLY OF FRONT CLUTCH

1. REMOVE THRUST BEARINGS AND RACES FROM BOTH SIDES OF CLUTCH
Note the position of the races.

2. USE EXTENSION HOUSING AS WORK STAND

3. REMOVE SNAP RING FROM FRONT CLUTCH DRUM

4. REMOVE FRONT AND REAR CLUTCH HUB
Lift out the two clutch hubs together.
